shape: Multi-zone arena (N+S diagonal gates, center hub + east pocket + west arrival)
description: Large multi-zone combat arena with portals on diagonal corners: north gate at top-center (X≈-0.5, Z≈-24), south gate at far-west (X≈-14, Z≈24). Four loosely-defined zones: a north entry zone, a richly-connected center hub (zd3ww1), an east-side detour pocket (fmnh55 + east corners), and a south/west arrival zone leading to spawn_south. The center hub is the highest-degree anchor and the natural cross-zone transit point.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-0.55, -24.22) — gate on the north (low-Z) end, near center X
portals.south: spawn_south at (-13.82, 24.36) — gate on the south (high-Z) end, far WEST

anchors.description: high-degree center hub — connects N entry zone, E pocket, S transit, and W zone (matches zd3ww1)
south-inner area, between center and SW arrival (matches un3by9)
SW far corner — dead-end pocket (matches tet32r)
SW entry hub, joins south_gate (matches t629ih)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S backbone: spawn_north → n_entry → n_inner → center_hub → sw_mid → sw_entry → spawn_south. Six hops via the high-degree center_hub.
EAST POCKET (east_inner, east_corner_n, east_corner_s) is a side combat arena — reach via center_hub → east_inner → corner → reverse.
SW DEAD-END (sw_far) is a single-degree detour off sw_mid; likely an objective spot.

DISPATCH RULE: center_hub is the cross-zone pivot. Same-zone objectives stay within their cluster (n_inner/n_entry for north zone, east_inner for east pocket, sw_mid for SW zone). Cross-zone routing always passes through center_hub.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
